problem:
Let $V={R}_{2}[t]$ be the vector space of all polynomials of degree at most $2$, equipped with the inner product

$$
⟨x(t),y(t)⟩=x(1)y(1)+x(2)y(2)+x(3)y(3).
$$

Find $⟨x(t),y(t)⟩$, if

$$
x(t)={t}^{2}-2,\,y(t)={t}^{2}+t.
$$

feedback.problem:
Let $V={R}_{2}[t]$ be the vector space of all polynomials of degree at most $2$, equipped with the inner product 

$$
⟨x(t),y(t)⟩=x(-2)y(-2)+x(-1)y(-1)+x(0)y(0).
$$

 Find $⟨x(t),y(t)⟩$, if

$$
x(t)={t}^{2}+3t+2,\,y(t)=t-1.
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Computing the inner product according to the definition, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨x(t),y(t)⟩ & =x(-2)y(-2)+x(-1)y(-1)+x(0)y(0). \\  & =0\cdot (-3)+0\cdot (-2)+2\cdot (-1) \\  & =0+0-2 \\  & =-2.\end{aligned}
$$
